name: Abyssocorda profunda
story: Lives deep and cold and makes no mushroom. Thick dark cords with very long unbranched runs; material moves through them a hundred times slower than in a rhizomorph. Invented by Claude on 2026-11-10 for the plugins: not a real species, and any likeness of the name to a real one is accidental. It takes every value it does not set from the RHIZ family.
